job.title: Recruitment Consultant
job.description:
Recruitment Consultant – Sydney CBD

Quay (Ethos BeathChapman) is looking for a Recruitment Consultant to join our Sydney CBD team, working across Government and Banking/FS clients.

This is a split desk across temporary and permanent recruitment, with an established foundation of temporary revenue already allocated to the desk. The opportunity is for someone who can take that existing base and build further growth across both temp and perm.

The role
You’ll work across a mix of Government and Banking clients, managing the recruitment process from candidate sourcing through to placement and ongoing client relationships.
The desk already has active temporary business, so you won’t be starting from scratch. We’re looking for someone who enjoys developing relationships, winning new business and building a desk over the longer term.

You’ll have the opportunity to:
  • Manage existing temporary recruitment requirements and grow the contractor base
  • Develop permanent recruitment opportunities across Commercial and Banking/FS
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships
  • Source, interview and represent candidates
  • Develop new business and identify opportunities within existing accounts
  • Work closely with clients to understand their hiring needs and provide market advice
  • Build your own network and profile across your specialist market
What we’re looking for
We’re open to different levels of recruitment experience, but you’ll ideally have:
  • Previous agency recruitment experience
  • A genuine interest in Banking/Financial Services recruitment
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
  • A commercial mindset and interest in business development
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and work autonomously
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to contribute to the wider team
We’re also open to someone looking to work 4 days per week and provide a hybrid work environment

Why this role?
  • Sydney CBD location
  • Split temporary and permanent desk
  • Existing temporary revenue base to build from
  • Established Government and Banking client relationships
  • Opportunity to drive your own growth and develop the desk
  • Flexible approach to working arrangements
  • Sponsorship available for the right person
Sponsorship is available, however applicants must already be based in Australia and be available to commence December 2026 / January 2027.
If you're interested or would like to have a confidential chat about the role, email Jessica Priebee at jpriebee@quayappointments.com.au with any questions.

job.title: Office & Continuous Improvement Manager
job.description:
Office & Continuous Improvement Manager
Sydney CBD | Hybrid | Full-time

We’re working with an established consulting firm based near Wynyard in Sydney CBD who are looking for an Office & Continuous Improvement Manager to take ownership of office operations while playing a key role across business systems, process improvement, compliance and change initiatives.

This is a broad role that sits across business operations, systems implementation, stakeholder management, compliance and continuous improvement. You’ll work closely with senior stakeholders and teams across the business to implement new systems, improve existing processes, maintain compliance and ensure changes are successfully adopted.

About the role
You will be responsible for coordinating and driving a range of operational and continuous improvement initiatives, while also overseeing the day-to-day administrative requirements of the office.
A key focus will be supporting the business through system implementations and process changes. You’ll work alongside business stakeholders to understand requirements, coordinate implementation activities, follow up actions and ensure teams are confident using new systems and processes.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Coordinating and supporting the implementation of new business systems and technology
  • Working with stakeholders to understand business requirements and identify process improvements
  • Following up stakeholders to ensure agreed actions are completed
  • Supporting change management and user adoption across the business
  • Developing processes, procedures, user guides and supporting documentation
  • Identifying inefficiencies and recommending practical improvements
  • Supporting the business to maintain key compliance requirements, policies, procedures and internal controls
  • Working with stakeholders to identify compliance gaps and implement improvements
  • Supporting the review and development of policies and procedures
  • Supporting stakeholders through changes to systems, processes and ways of working
  • Helping teams build confidence and capability with new systems
  • Reviewing existing business processes and identifying opportunities for greater efficiency
  • Coordinating meetings, actions and project requirements across multiple stakeholders
  • Overseeing general office operations and administration
  • Providing administrative and executive support to senior stakeholders as required

About you
We’re looking for someone who is organised, commercially minded, confident with stakeholders and genuinely interested in how businesses operate.
You may come from an EA, Executive Assistant, Office Manager, Business Operations, Business Support, Project Coordination or Continuous Improvement background and be looking for an opportunity to broaden your experience.
You’ll ideally have:
  • Experience working in a business operations, EA, office management, business support or project environment
  • Experience supporting system implementations, technology projects or business process improvements
  • Experience working with compliance requirements, policies, procedures or internal controls
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • The confidence to work with senior stakeholders and influence people to complete agreed actions
  • Strong project coordination and organisational skills
  • Experience supporting change and helping users adopt new systems or processes
  • A practical approach to problem-solving and process improvement
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • The ability to work independently and take ownership of initiatives
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
You don't need to be a technical systems specialist. We’re looking for someone who can understand business requirements, coordinate implementation activities, work with stakeholders and make sure new systems and processes are successfully embedded within the business.

Why this role?
This is an opportunity to move beyond a traditional administration or EA role and take on broader responsibility across business operations, systems, compliance, projects and continuous improvement.
You’ll have genuine exposure to system implementations and business improvement initiatives, working directly with stakeholders to help shape and embed new ways of working.

For a confidential discussion about this opportunity please reach out to Jessica Priebee jpriebee@quayappointments.com.au
Working Holiday Visa holders are welcome to apply.

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Senior Business Services & Tax Accountant
Sydney CBD | Boutique Accounting & Advisory Firm

An established boutique accounting and advisory firm based in Sydney CBD is looking to add a Senior Business Services & Tax Accountant to their growing team. The firm works with High Net Worth Individuals, family groups and their associated businesses, providing a combination of Business Services, Tax, Virtual CFO and Estate Planning services.
This is a hands-on role suited to an experienced Business Services & Tax Accountant who enjoys working closely with clients and wants exposure to more than just compliance.

The Role
Working across a portfolio of private clients and their businesses, you will be responsible for:
  • Preparing and reviewing financial accounts and tax returns for individuals, companies, trusts and other structures
  • Managing Business Services and tax compliance across a diverse client portfolio
  • Preparing BAS, IAS and other statutory requirements
  • Providing tax planning and general tax advice
  • Assisting with budgeting, forecasting and management reporting
  • Working with clients and their advisers to understand their broader financial and business needs
  • Assisting with Virtual CFO services and business advisory projects
  • Liaising with clients, auditors, financial advisers, lawyers and other professional advisers
  • Supporting more complex client matters and ad hoc advisory work as required
About You
You will ideally have:
  • CA/CPA qualification or be working towards completion
  • 3+ years' experience in Business Services and Tax within an Australian accounting firm
  • Strong experience preparing financial statements and tax returns across a range of entity types
  • Good knowledge of Australian tax legislation and compliance requirements
  • Experience working directly with clients and managing your own portfolio
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
  • A commercial mindset and an interest in understanding the broader needs of clients
  • Experience with Xero and/or similar accounting software
What’s on Offer
  • Sydney CBD location
  • Boutique, professional working environment
  • Exposure to High Net Worth Individuals, family groups and privately owned businesses
  • Variety across Business Services, Tax, Virtual CFO and advisory work
  • Opportunity to develop your technical and commercial skills
  • Close access to senior leadership and experienced advisers
  • Competitive salary based on experience + performance based bonus scheme
If you're an experienced Business Services & Tax Accountant looking for a role with greater exposure to advisory work and a high-quality client base, we'd be interested in hearing from you. Jpriebee@quayappointments.com.au
